name: @pistols-solitaire/torii
description: Torii indexer deployment: config generation, Docker image, Railway ops

scripts.dev: TORII_DB_DIR=./data/torii-db PORT=${PORT:-8080} pnpm run config && torii --config ./torii.generated.toml
scripts.docker:run: docker run --rm -it -p 8080:8080 -p 9200:9200 -e NETWORK=${NETWORK:-SN_MAIN} -e PORT=8080 -v pistols-solitaire-torii-db:/data pistols-solitaire-torii
